title: Token Masters
html:
Token Masters are NPCs in Townston that exchange King's Coins for equipment. They stand on the path from the Obelisk up toward the bank.

  • Fighter Equip Token Master
  • Mage Equip Token Master
  • Ranger Equip Token Master
  • No longer in the game: Jewelry Token Master

Prices are about 3 to 15 King's Coins. The item is random, class-appropriate, and near your level. It is usually yellow, sometimes purple, and soulbound on purchase.

Also see Sam's Dungeon Wholesale and the Wishing Well.
